design_philosophy: Warm, tactile, and compassionate. Avoid cold clinical blues and sterile greys. The platform must feel like a high-end boutique physical therapy clinic. For clinicians: clarity and trust. For pet owners: encouragement and approachability.

spacing_and_layout.scale: Generous spacing. Use p-6, p-8, and p-12 extensively. Avoid cramped UI.

grid_strategy.clinician_dashboard: Mode B (Control Room Grid). Tight gap-6, pure flat cards. No messy staggered heights for data.
grid_strategy.owner_portal: Mobile-first, stacked bento style. gap-4, large tap targets (min 48px height).

spacing_and_layout.border_radius: rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl for cards. Inner elements rounded-xl to maintain concentricity.

surfaces_and_shadows.cards: Flat background (bg-card), 1px subtle border (border-border), NO heavy shadows. Clean, grounded look.
surfaces_and_shadows.glassmorphism: Avoid in clinical areas to prevent visual refraction. Use flat solid backgrounds.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or large radius (rounded-xl). Primary buttons use Terracotta (#C96A52). Explicit hover states (e.g., hover:bg-[#B35A44]).
components.inputs: Shadcn UI, highly customized: bg-[#F3F0EB], border-transparent, focus:border-[#C96A52] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#C96A52].
components.tags_badges: Soft backgrounds (e.g., bg-[#E8E2D9] text-[#2C312E]) for condition tags or breed.
components.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone or Regular weight). They feel more premium and approachable than Lucide.

motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Active states must have clear contrast. Hover states shift background color by 10% lightness.
motion_and_interactions.accessibility: Always respect prefers-reduced-motion. High contrast focus rings mandatory.

image_urls.description: Veterinarian with dog. Use for Landing Page Hero or Clinician Dashboard Welcome.
Brown and white border collie mix. Use for Patient Profile placeholder or Owner Portal Hero.
Happy shaggy dog in grass. Use for Success states, empty states, or completed exercise log.
Black dog running in field. Use for exercise library generic placeholder.

media.treatment: Images must have max opacity black/30 overlay if text is overlaid. Soft rounded corners (rounded-2xl) matching the UI.

testing.requirements: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react framer-motion clsx tailwind-merge
Update tailwind.config.js to use the specified Organic & Earthy color variables, overriding the default Shadcn greys. Map them to the HSL values natively expected by Shadcn.
Add 'Cabinet Grotesk' (via Fontshare CDN) and 'Manrope' (via Google Fonts). Implement font-family classes in Tailwind.
Build the Clinician Dashboard with a fixed left sidebar and a dense but well-padded Mode B grid.
Build the Owner Portal mobile-first with large tap targets and encouraging typography.
Ensure the Exercise Library uses Shadcn Cards, heavily customized to remove shadows and add 1px borders.
Do NOT use generic medical blue. Use the Terracotta (#C96A52) primary color.
Never use placeholder image services (like via.placeholder.com). Use the exact URLs provided in the media section.
Ensure data-testid attributes are thoroughly applied.
